benefit.name: WorkBC Employment Services
benefit.amount: Free employment services, including work experience and wage subsidies. Funding support for training, transportation, dependent care and employment-related disability supports may be available, typically for clients with an employment plan.
benefit.summary: BC's free public employment service. Help finding work, possible funding support for training, and possible financial supports, with services built specifically for people with disabilities.
benefit.requiresNote: Check whether you are eligible by applying online at apply.workbc.ca. Staff can support you in completing your application.
benefit.note: If you have a disability, job search help includes working with employers to shape or customize jobs to meet your needs. Funding for assistive technology is covered by a separate program in this catalog: WorkBC Assistive Technology Services.

detail.about: WorkBC centres provide free employment services including job-search help, work experience and wage subsidies. Funding support for training and employment-related disability supports may be available, typically for clients with an employment plan. A WorkBC counsellor reviews eligibility and builds the plan with you.

aboutList.lead: WorkBC centre services and possible funding:
items: Free employment services including job-search help, work experience and wage subsidies.
Funding support for training and employment-related disability supports may be available, typically for clients with an employment plan.
A WorkBC counsellor reviews eligibility and builds the plan with you.

steps: Get a Basic BCeID or set up online access with a BC Services Card
Register for Online Employment Services and select WorkBC Employment Services
Complete the application, including work status, barriers and the WorkBC centre you want to use
Upload requested documents and communicate with the centre through the secure portal
Meet an employment counsellor to confirm eligibility and create a personal action plan
documents: Information showing you are legally allowed to work in B.C.
Information about disability-related employment barriers if requesting specialized supports
tips: You do not need a phone number or a fixed mailing address to submit the online application
Centre staff can help you complete the application
People with disabilities can qualify in more work or student situations. These include being at risk of losing a job or being in the final year of school
Financial supports are typically for clients who are case managed through WorkBC. That means you have an employment plan and work with an employment specialist.
Dependent care covers childcare while you are job searching.
detail.time: The local WorkBC centre decides eligibility after reviewing the completed application

meta.effort: Online registration or local WorkBC intake
